method_summary: Popa deformation-rigidity with free-probabilistic microstate concentration and ultraproduct central-sequence analysis
problem_statement: Let M_3 = L_infty(O_3^+, h) be the II_1 factor of the Kac free orthogonal quantum group at N=3 with Haar trace h, and let A_0 = W*(u_11) be the von Neumann algebra generated by the first diagonal coefficient. Using Popa deformation-rigidity (a Caspers-type malleable/central-multiplier deformation) together with free-probabilistic microstate concentration and ultraproduct central-sequence analysis, decide the one-shape solidity question for A_0: prove that A_0 is maximal amenable in M_3 (blocking that Cartan shape), or otherwise produce an explicit microstate central-sequence witness. The N=3 cell is chosen because N=2 is coamenable while the Connes-embedding/microstate theorem covers only N>=4.
record_title: Maximal amenability of the generator MASA in L_infty(O_3^+): a one-shape solidity certificate
